\[

\]

In \(\triangle AIC\), the angle at \(A\) is \(A/2\), so

\[

\[

\[
t^2=\frac{s}{2s+b}

\frac{s}{b}=\frac{t^2}{1-2t^2}.

\[
\frac{2s+b}{b+2\ell}

\frac{125}{6}.
\]

\[
